concepts.learning_objective: Create strings using single, double and triple quotes.
Access characters of a string using positive and negative indices.
Recognise when an out-of-range index raises IndexError.
Explain that the contents of a string cannot be changed after creation.
Apply the + and * operators to join and repeat strings.
Use in and not in to test for substrings.
Extract substrings with str[n:m], including omitted and negative indices.
Use a step size in slicing, including negative steps to reverse a string.
Traverse a string character by character with a for loop.
Traverse a string using a while loop, an index and len().
Use methods such as title(), upper() and lower() to change case.
Use find(), index() and count() to locate and count substrings.
Apply split(), join(), strip() and replace() to transform strings.

topics.title: Handling strings with user defined functions

concepts.learning_objective: Trace user defined functions that count or replace characters in a string.
Reverse a string with negative indices and check for palindromes.
